name: Ubukata Yuuko
source: The protagonist aunt and the oldest of three sisters. Is very kind always looking out for him and trying to be peace keeper between two younger sisters. She decides to help protagonist with sexual urges if he promises not to act on them with his mom.
translation: 主人公的阿姨，也是三姐妹中的长女。她非常温柔，总是照顾主人公，还试图在两个妹妹之间充当和事佬。她决定帮助主人公解决性欲，但条件是主人公不能对母亲出手。
